newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade on Monday with most traders sidelined due mainly to the absence of fresh incentives, dealers said.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. There's no (U.S.) economic indicators coming out tonight and most people were reluctant to open or hold new positions," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for Tuesday's issue of the (U.S. May) consumer credit index and Friday's release of the (U.S. June) producer price index data," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8, nine-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent.
